newsitem.title: CHINA: Cheung Kong's new flats 14X subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong's new flats 14X subscribed.

text.p: Cheung Kong Holdings Ltd said on Monday the first batch of flats at its residential development in Shatin in the New Territories was about 14 times subscribed in the first day of registration.

The company said in a statement some 2,800 potential buyers registered on Monday for the 204 units available for sale at Vista Paradiso, a joint venture project equally owned by Cheung Kong and Concord Land Development Co Ltd.
Cheung Kong said it expected the subscription level to rise before registration closes on Wednesday.
The units will be sold on July 26.
The first batch of flats at Vista Paradiso, which has about 2,030 residential units in Ma On Shan, would be sold at HK$6,148 per square foot, the company said.
